notes: Setup is now about 0.6 GB on Mac and 0.9 GB on Windows. The AI engine and models download when you first dub, and only the ones you choose.
The dub-start dialog shows the download's progress and starts the dub when it is done. Settings can remove or reinstall the AI engine and the translation runtime.
Subtitles export exactly as the work screen shows them: the same line breaks, box and font weight.
The subtitle width handles follow the pointer for the whole drag.
